title: Advertising Sales Executive
description:
Office based in Glasgow

Our Client
- Is a leading multimedia company.
- They produce a range of high impact advertising platforms including publishing, websites, digital media and events.
- Provide quality analysis, insight, news, and information across their specialist sectors.
- Their products guarantees that their media reaches a targeted and specific audience which is hugely valuable to advertisers.
- Currently require an Advertising Sales Executive.

The Role

This is an opportunity to join an award-winning business who are a key player in their sectors.
- Focusing on new business generation
- Sourcing leads and generating new business opportunities over the telephone via cold call telemarketing calls
- Also contacting existing customers from an existing database of clients.
- Identifying key contacts within companies and gathering data from a number of sources.
- Selling print and digital display, targeted social media campaigns, e-shots, sponsored articles and listicles.
- This is a structured sale where you will identify the business needs then create, design and present innovative advertising solutions tailored to the client to ensure results
- Negotiating and presenting bespoke print and digital advertising solutions to key decision makers.
- Working closely with the digital editorial/ content teams and media sales team
- Occasionally presenting and negotiating with customers face to face.
- Working to revenue targets and deadlines.
- Dealing with a range of customers from SMEs to corporate clients on a national basis.
- Keeping internal CRM System up to date

The Candidate
- Ideally require a minimum of 6 months successful track record selling any form of media / advertising space (ie. newspaper, magazines, radio, directory, etc).
- Consideration will also be given candidates with B2 B sales experience with experience of the full sales cycle.

You will have
- A solid understanding of the full sales process.
- Be a self-starter with strong initiative and highly motivated.
- An interest in the media and marketing sector
- Commercial awareness.
- Motivated and enthusiastic with an ethical approach to sales.
- Creative, articulate, proactive and quick thinking with the ability to develop relationships.
- Ability to deal at all levels.
- Desire to pursue a career in the exciting world of media sales.

The Package

In return
- You will be given the opportunity to work for a market leading media organisation.
- Opportunity to join a company that value their staff and customers and provide the investment in retaining them.
- Full training, development back-up and development opportunities associated with a highly professional media organisation.

Basic to £30 K + uncapped bonus (1st Year OTE £36 K) + benefits

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
This is an excellent opportunity for a digital marketing professional to take ownership of SEO, website content, paid campaigns and performance analytics within a highly regarded Scottish professional services organisation. You'll play a key role in driving online visibility and campaign effectiveness while working in a collaborative, award-winning environment.

Client Details

Our client is a leading Scottish professional services organisation with a longstanding reputation for excellence, innovation and client service. Recognised multiple times as a Law Firm of the Year and known for its collaborative, people-focused culture, the business combines commercial ambition with a strong commitment to employee development, ESG principles and making a positive impact in the communities it serves.

Description

We're seeking an ambitious Digital Marketing Executive to lead and support a broad range of digital marketing activities across SEO, website content, paid campaigns and performance analytics.

This role would suit someone who enjoys combining creativity with data, and who is motivated by improving digital performance through insight-led decision making.

Key Responsibilities

SEO & Website Performance
- Conduct keyword research and identify opportunities to increase organic visibility
- Optimise on-page content and support SEO best practice across the website
- Keep digital content fresh, relevant and aligned with business objectives
- Create, edit and publish content through CMS platforms including WordPress

Digital Campaigns
- Support the planning and delivery of integrated marketing campaigns
- Manage and optimise paid digital activity across PPC and paid social channels
- Assist with email marketing campaigns and audience engagement initiatives
- Collaborate with stakeholders to maximise campaign effectiveness

Analytics & Reporting
- Monitor campaign and website performance using Google Analytics and other reporting tools
- Translate marketing data into actionable insights and recommendations
- Produce meaningful reports for internal stakeholders
- Drive continuous improvement through evidence-based decision making

Collaboration
- Work closely with senior stakeholders and subject matter experts across the business
- Support broader marketing and business development initiatives
- Stay ahead of emerging digital marketing trends and best practices

Profile

You'll bring:
- At least 3 years' experience in a digital marketing role
- Strong knowledge of SEO, content optimisation and digital marketing best practice
- Hands-on experience managing PPC and paid social campaigns
- Experience using CMS platforms such as WordPress
- Strong analytical skills and confidence working with digital performance data
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
- A highly organised approach with strong attention to detail
- Experience within a B2 B or professional services environment would be advantageous but is not essential.

Job Offer
- Join an award-winning Scottish organisation with an exceptional reputation in its sector.
- Be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking culture built around innovation, openness and continuous improvement.
- Gain exposure to a sophisticated marketing environment where digital channels play a key role in business growth.
- Work with experienced professionals and influential stakeholders across the organisation.
- A varied role offering ownership across SEO, content, paid media and analytics rather than being confined to a single marketing discipline.
- Hybrid working and an inclusive culture committed to supporting employee development and wellbeing.
- Enhanced benefits package.
- Salary between 35-45,000 per annum.

If you're a commercially minded digital marketer who enjoys turning data into results and wants to make a genuine impact, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Marketing & Social Media Administrator
description:
Marketing & Social Media Administrator

Full-Time Permanent Queenslie

Are you a creative and commercially minded marketing professional looking for an opportunity to make a real impact?

My client is embarking on an exciting growth journey and is looking to bring their marketing activities in-house for the first time. This is a unique opportunity to take ownership of the company's marketing strategy, elevate brand awareness, and drive commercial growth through engaging digital content and social media campaigns.

As the Marketing & Social Media Executive, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the company's online presence, developing creative marketing initiatives, and creating content that generates engagement, leads, and business opportunities.

This role would suit someone who enjoys working autonomously, bringing fresh ideas to the table, and seeing the direct impact of their work on business success.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage all social media channels (Facebook, Instagram,TikTok and Pinterest)
- Create Engaging photo and video content
- Plan and schedule social media posts
- Work with ChatGPT to create blogs, adverts, emails and marketing campaigns
- Keep the website updated with new products and projects
- Collect customer reviews and testimonials
- Run Meta and Google advertising campaigns
- Track marketing performance and report results
- Respond quickly to online enquiries
- Organise and attend customer events

About You

The successful candidate will have:
- Previous experience in a marketing, digital marketing, or social media-focused role
- Experience managing business social media accounts and growing online engagement
- Strong understanding of social media platforms, digital marketing tools, and analytics
- Creative thinking with a strong commercial mindset
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
- The ability to work independently and take ownership of marketing initiatives

title: Marketing and Communications Executive
description:
This is an excellent opportunity for a talented marketing and communications professional to lead engaging content and PR activity within a highly respected Scottish professional services organisation. You'll help tell compelling stories, enhance brand visibility and support strategic communications initiatives while working with senior stakeholders across the business.

Client Details

A professional services firm based in Glasgow. A trusted client regarding which we've had nothing but positive feedback from candidates placed there.

Description

We're partnering with a highly regarded Scottish firm to appoint a Marketing & Communications Executive on a 12-month maternity cover contract. This is an exciting opportunity for a skilled communicator, content creator and storyteller to join a collaborative marketing team and play a key role in strengthening brand awareness, reputation and market engagement.

The organisation has an outstanding reputation for innovation, client service and responsible business practices, and is recognised as one of Scotland's leading firms in its field.

The Opportunity

This broad and varied role will see you lead the creation of compelling content, support PR initiatives and help deliver impactful communications across multiple channels.

You'll work closely with senior stakeholders, subject matter experts and the wider marketing team to identify stories, develop campaigns and ensure consistent messaging across all communications activity.

Key Responsibilities

Content & Communications
- Create high-quality content for websites, social media, email campaigns and internal communications
- Develop engaging stories that support business priorities and strengthen brand visibility
- Ensure all communications are aligned to brand guidelines and tone of voice
- Support content planning and execution across multiple channels

PR & Media Relations
- Assist with the development and delivery of PR campaigns
- Draft press releases, media materials and thought leadership content
- Identify opportunities to enhance the organisation's profile through media and communications activity
- Support wider reputation-building initiatives

Reporting & Insight
- Analyse campaign and content performance
- Produce clear reports and actionable recommendations for stakeholders
- Use audience and performance data to drive continuous improvement

Collaboration
- Partner with senior stakeholders across the business to uncover compelling stories and opportunities
- Support broader marketing and business development initiatives
- Keep up to date with industry trends and emerging communications best practice

Profile

A successful Marketing and Communications Executive should have:
- At least 3 years' experience within marketing, communications, PR or digital marketing
- Exceptional writing, editing and storytelling ability
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
- Experience creating content across a variety of platforms and audiences
- A data-led approach with the ability to interpret performance insights
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail
- Experience within a B2 B or professional services environment would be advantageous but is not essential.

Job Offer
- Join an award-winning Scottish organisation with a reputation for excellence and innovation.
- Work in a collaborative environment where ideas, initiative and creativity are valued.
- Gain exposure to a broad mix of content marketing, PR and strategic communications activity.
- Build relationships with senior stakeholders and contribute to high-profile business initiatives.
- Play a visible role in shaping brand reputation and market presence.
- Salary between 35-45,000 per annum and an enhanced benefits package.

If you're a talented writer, confident communicator and natural storyteller looking for a varied and engaging role, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Sales Account Manager (Marketing Solutions)
description:
The Client
- A market leading, cutting edge marketing company and the winner of a number of prestigious business awards.
- They provide their blue chip and SME clients with promotional and retail space in high footfall venues,
- Venues include shopping centres, garden centres, city centres, train stations, retail parks, festivals and airports throughout the UK and abroad.
- These are controlled environments where their brand product or service is placed directly in front of their potential customer audience.
- No.1 in their market their clients include Mercedes, BMW, Lego, Virgin, Sky, Schweppes and BT to name but a few.
- This innovative organisation have experienced continued growth through organic expansion and acquisition due to their unique product offering and increasing product portfolio.

The Role

They currently require a Sales Account Manager.
- To sell their range of marketing/ promotional, retail & media space
- Customers will be a mix of global brands, retailers, experiential marketing agencies, PR firms, local businesses and independent promoters.
- Dealing with a mix of new (50%) and existing customers (50%).
- Role will involve taking inbound calls and making outbound calls to generate business.
- Obtain an understanding of client requirements at both a strategic and a tactical level to be able to offer the best business solutions.
- You will have access to an existing database from which you will contact key decision makers to present their attractive media and retail solutions.
- This will involve working a relaxed, fast paced environment to deadlines and revenue targets.
- You will have the support and back up of strong case studies, metrics and marketing information

The Candidate
- Ideally require a minimum of 6 months successful track record selling any form of media / advertising space (ie. newspaper, magazines, radio, directory, etc).
- Alternatively you will have sales experience from any sector with a genuine interest in marketing.

You will have
- A solid understanding of the sales process.
- An interest in the marketing sector
- Commercial awareness.
- Motivated and enthusiastic with an ethical approach to sales.
- Creative, articulate, proactive and quick thinking with the ability to develop relationships.
- Ability to deal at all levels.
- Desire to pursue a career in the exciting world of marketing and media sales.

The Package

In return you will be given
- The opportunity to join a growing, friendly and innovative successful team.
- Genuine career development and progression opportunities exist.
- Full training

title: Social Media & Office Support Apprentice
description:
LAT_56 is a premium bag and luggage brand creating products for work, travel and everyday life. We are seeking a motivated and creative apprentice who will split their time between LAT_56 and Core Facilities, gaining valuable experience across two growing businesses.

This is an exciting opportunity to work towards a recognised apprenticeship qualification while developing practical skills in marketing, business operations, customer engagement and digital technologies. Working alongside experienced professionals from both companies, you'll contribute to real business projects, learn how different organisations operate, and build the knowledge, skills and behaviours needed for a successful career.

Job responsibilities:
- Support the planning, creation and scheduling of digital content across social media channels, including TikTok, Instagram and LinkedIn
- Become a competent user of CRM, marketing and business systems, ensuring information is maintained accurately
- Assist with the delivery of digital marketing campaigns to increase brand awareness, engagement and customer reach
- Use collaborative technologies such as Microsoft Teams, SharePoint and other digital platforms to communicate and work effectively with colleagues
- Create basic marketing assets such as social media posts, email content, blogs and promotional materials
- Monitor and report on campaign performance using analytics and marketing tools, identifying opportunities for improvement
- Research market trends, competitor activity and customer behaviours to support marketing decisions and campaign planning
- Contribute creative ideas and support partnerships, customer engagement activities and brand-building initiatives that help achieve business objectives

Required skills:
- Creative mindset
- Ambitious, hardworking and motivated by measurable success
- Confident communicating with people
- Curious and comfortable with social media and digital trends
- Organised, self-directed and eager to learn from experienced colleagues

Working hours: Monday to Thursday 8.30am - 5pm, Friday 8.30am - 4pm

Benefits:
- Coaching and mentoring from experienced marketing professionals.
- Onsite parking
- Pension (if eligible)

Future prospects:

90% of QA apprentices secure permanent employment after completing: this is 20% higher than the national average.

Important information:

This vocational apprenticeship comprehensively supports your specific job role with this particular employer. Throughout your learning journey, you are fully supported by your dedicated QA skills coach and your mentor at work. They ensure you settle in, help you develop all the skills you need to be successful in your job role and pass your assessments, and can provide one to one support.

Starting with insights into your current potential, they plan your growth in a programmatic way, close skills gaps with immersive training and ensure what you learn is applicable to what you do. They talk you through the specifics on the qualifications you gain and how they align in particular to your day to day role.

On completion, as well as the valuable work experience you have gained, you get a nationally recognised qualification at SCQF Level 6.

If you are interested in starting your career and receiving a work based qualification at the same time APPLY NOW!
